fig1_clt_convergence.svg: Starting from a clearly non-normal parent (a flat fair die), the exact standardized distribution of the sum S_n is obtained by n-fold convolution and overlaid for n=1,2,4,16. As n grows the lattice distribution converges to the standard normal density (thick curve).
fig2_convergence_rate.svg: The largest gap between the standardized cdf of S_n and the normal cdf Phi, plotted against n on log-log axes for the fair die. The error sits under the Berry-Esseen bound and decays like 1/sqrt(n); the continuity correction lowers it further.
